parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-chosen key (1 to 200 printable characters). A repeat of the same request on the same route with the same key within 24 hours returns the first response (status and body, header Idempotency-Replayed: true); a refusal (4xx) is replayed too, a server failure (5xx) is not stored. The same key with another request is 422 idempotency-key-reused.
